title: Suggestion board additions — round 2 (site and pipeline improvements)
policy: Nothing here is implemented. Each suggestion is a choice with three paths; the recommended column is a default, not a decision. This register exists so someone can review and choose the best path BEFORE any change is made.

rows.suggestion: Unify the eight parallel site sections behind one navigation
rows.rationale: The repo publishes eight sections (app, pages, dashboard, research, site, live, hub, archive). F-10 records it as the largest irregularity; a decision-maker has to know which section is canonical for what.
rows.risk: low — reversible, nothing is deleted (sections are archived, not removed)
rows.path_a: A: promote app/ as the single dashboard; move the other sections under an 'archive' nav group
rows.path_b: B: keep all sections and add a permanent section-switcher header on every page
rows.path_c: C: leave as-is, rely on the hub section index

rows.suggestion: Automate price-snapshot capture (open at origination, close at kickoff)
rows.rationale: The store exists and records our numbers, but captures are manual and the first close was missed. Automation is what makes open/close data reliable.
rows.risk: low — additive workflow step; a failed capture is recorded as missed and never back-filled
rows.path_a: A: extend the data-refresh workflow to snapshot prices at origination and kickoff (needs Q-31)
rows.path_b: B: manual capture with a checklist per week
rows.path_c: C: defer until a price feed exists

rows.suggestion: Automate settlement and ROI publication from the verified results feed
rows.rationale: Grading currently runs when the generator runs. An automated settle step after each game window keeps the leaderboard current with no manual input (a brief requirement).
rows.risk: low — grading is deterministic from official finals; re-grading rules are the open part (Q-33)
rows.path_a: A: settle inside the data-refresh workflow after each game window (needs Q-33)
rows.path_b: B: settle weekly in a manual run
rows.path_c: C: settle only at season end

rows.suggestion: Add a closing-line-value column and wire demotion trigger G-D1.T3
rows.rationale: CLV is the fastest signal that an edge is gone. The signal scorecard has a reserved column; the demotion gate defines the trigger but cannot run without close captures.
rows.risk: medium — CLV needs both a price source and clean close captures
rows.path_a: A: compute CLV from the price store once Q-31 lands and enable T3
rows.path_b: B: enable T3 without CLV, on ROI windows only
rows.path_c: C: drop T3 from the demotion gate

rows.suggestion: Decision-first KPI strip on the Overview page (open decisions, blocked gates, unverified cells)
rows.rationale: Decision-making improves when the state of the decision surface is visible on arrival, not three clicks deep.
rows.path_a: A: KPI strip computed from the decision and flag registers
rows.path_b: B: a single link to the decision register

rows.suggestion: Map the three parallel strategy registries (S1-n, S_*, ST-*) into one crosswalk
rows.rationale: Three registries describe strategies with different ids. A reviewer cannot tell whether two rows describe the same idea, and the leaderboard split references S_* keys only.
rows.risk: low — a mapping table changes no data
rows.path_a: A: publish a crosswalk table (ids mapped, no merge)
rows.path_b: B: merge into one registry now
